org/springframework/scheduling/annotatio.summary: Annotation that marks a method to be scheduled. Exactly one of the cron, fixedDelay, or fixedRate attributes must be specified.

cron.summary: A cron-like expression, extending the usual UN*X definition.

zone.summary: A time zone for which the cron expression will be resolved.

fixedDelay.summary: Execute the annotated method with a fixed period in milliseconds between the end of the last invocation and the start of the next.

fixedDelayString.summary: Execute the annotated method with a fixed period between the end of the last invocation and the start of the next, given as a string (placeholder/SpEL allowed).

fixedRate.summary: Execute the annotated method with a fixed period in milliseconds between invocations.

fixedRateString.summary: Execute the annotated method with a fixed period between invocations, given as a string (placeholder/SpEL allowed).

initialDelay.summary: Number of units of time to delay before the first execution of a fixedRate or fixedDelay task.

timeUnit.summary: The TimeUnit to use for fixedDelay, fixedDelayString, fixedRate, fixedRateString, and initialDelay values.

org/springframework/scheduling/annotatio.summary: Container annotation that aggregates several @Scheduled annotations.
Enables Spring's scheduled task execution capability.
Annotation that marks a method as a candidate for asynchronous execution.

value.summary: A qualifier value for the specified asynchronous operation(s).

org/springframework/scheduling/annotatio.summary: Enables Spring's asynchronous method execution capability.

notes: Scheduling triggers are mutually exclusive: exactly one of cron/fixedDelay/fixedRate (with their *String alternates) must be set per @Scheduled. *String variants exist specifically to allow ${...} placeholder values resolved against Environment — KS work.
